agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms, but a ripe ear left standing while dawn still takes two corn is the other ending. Pull it while the ditch still holds the gauge.
today.expect: Corn in the bin and an empty field before the ration can outrun the crop.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Yesterday's pour took eight from the cistern under clear sky — fill it back to the brim before the growing row asks again.
yesterday.expect: Cistern topped so tomorrow's field work never races the gauge.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. The second Bob clears the ear, the next row goes in — heat does not wait for an empty sack.
today.expect: A seeded row catching tomorrow's moisture while the harvest sits in the bin.

yesterday.why: Ditches compound. Heat does not wait — read the east row after the pour and the sprout-to-growing advance, not after a wasted seed. Unused seeds stay a delay only if we plant into a full field.
yesterday.expect: A moisture and crop reading before the next experimental move.
